reader.requirement: At --std 85 the I-O-CONTROL paragraph must accept the header alone, or the header followed by one or more SAME {RECORD|SORT|SORT-MERGE} [AREA] [FOR] file-name-1 {file-name-2}... clauses written as one run closed by a single separator period, and run the sorts it names; it must refuse a run with no closing period, a period inside the run, a clause naming fewer than two files, a misspelled phrase word, an undeclared file, and the 2023 APPLY COMMIT clause. The witnesses cover the period rules, the closed clause list, the two-file minimum (RECORD) and SORT/SORT-MERGE use.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses the 2023 APPLY COMMIT clause below 2023 (COBOL0900)
below 2002 a report file may be named in SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA clauses (§1985:XIII.2.4.3 SR2); the sort-merge and other-file rows are the same at every edition
the sequential-module MULTIPLE FILE TAPE clause (obsolete from 2002), a sibling clause of the paragraph outside this format
the sequential-module RERUN clause (obsolete), a sibling clause outside this format

reader.edition-search: grep Edition.Edition.Year/DialectLevel/Constructs in FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs (one hit, SameOccurrenceRule) and Visit*Clause of the I-O-CONTROL rules in VersionConformancePass.cs (no VisitSameClause); ScreenParagraphPeriods consults no edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the format: the SAME clause spellings, the single closing period and the two-file minimum are the same code at 85 and 2023 (p4a prints the same at both; p4g is COBOL3407 at both); only APPLY COMMIT (2023) and a report file's SAME SORT occurrence limit differ
reader.witnesses-cover: part: not exercised are the empty paragraph (I-O-CONTROL. alone), SAME SORT with AREA/FOR omitted, several SAME clauses in one sentence, SAME SORT naming one file, and APPLY COMMIT at 85

reader.notes: The union grammar I_O_CONTROL DOT (ioControlClause DOT?)* with sameClause and ClosedFormatPass's period screen implements the Sort-Merge I-O-CONTROL format at 85 exactly; ScreenSameOperands enforces the two-file minimum and FILE-CONTROL membership. Diagnostics at 85 cite ISO 2023 numbers (presentation only).

refuter.evidence: At --std 85, against the rules of the format's SAME clause the reader did not probe: s1 SAME SORT AREA naming an EXTERNAL FD -> COBOL2738 external file connector (SR2); s2 sort file S1 in two SAME SORT AREA clauses -> COBOL2738 (SR5b); s3 F2 in two SAME RECORD AREA clauses -> COBOL2738 (SR5a); s4 SAME AREA FOR F1 F2 + SAME SORT AREA FOR S1 F1 -> COBOL2738 omits F2 (SR5c), and s6 with F2 added compiles and sorts; s5 SAME SORT AREA FOR F1 F2 with no sort file -> COBOL2738 (GR2). Class d/GR1 sharing: s0 SAME RECORD AREA FOR F1 (PIC X(6)) F2 (group X(2)+X(2)): MOVE 'ABCDEF' TO F1R -> 'F2R=ABCD F2B=CD', MOVE 'WXYZ' TO F2R -> 'F1R=WXYZEF' (implicit redefinition, leftmost aligned); s7 'SAME SORT-MERGE FOR S1 S2 SAME RECORD F1 F2.' (AREA and/or FOR omitted) -> runs, same output. Class c (a 1985-only sibling in the same paragraph): s8 RERUN ON F1 EVERY END OF REEL OF F2 + SAME SORT AREA + MULTIPLE FILE TAPE CONTAINS F1 F2 -> runs at 85; at 2023 -> COBOL0902 RERUN and MULTIPLE FILE removed in 2002. cite.py: OK §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR2, SR5a, SR5b, SR5c; OK §1985:XI.2.5.4 GR1, GR2.
